arabic text: AIY IMAM-E-ZAMANA TERI RAAHA DEKHTEY HAI(N)\nTUJHE DEEKH KE YAAD AYEGI, KARBAL KI KAAHANI
english translation text: O IMAM-E-ZAMANA WE’RE AWAITING YOUR RETURN\nWHEN WE’LL SEE YOU WE’LL REMEMBER, THE EVENTS OF KARBALA

arabic text: AIY IMAM-E-ZAMANA TERI RAAHA DEKHTEY HAI(N)
english translation text: O IMAM-E-ZAMANA WE’RE AWAITING YOUR RETURN

arabic text: TUJHE DEEKH KE DO MANZAR YAAD AYENGE FARWA KO\nEIK TASHT-ME HAI(N) EIK HAI(N), SARWAR KI JO ABA MEI(N)\nKARBAL-ME JO TUKRE(N) HAI(N), QASSIM BADAN KE HAI(N)
english translation text: WHEN FARWA SEE’S YOU SHE’LL REMEMBER TWO EVENTS\nONE IS THE TRAY AND ONE IS HUSSAIN’S CLOAK\nTHE PIECES IN KARBALA ARE THE THOSE OF QASSIM’S BODY

arabic text: TUJHE DEEKH KE AKBAR KI YAAD AYEGI EIK MAA KO\nZAINAB-SE KOI PUUCHE, LAYLA KI JO HALAAT HAI(N)\nBABA KA JO SAHARA THA, WO ERIYA(N) RAGARTA HAI(N)
english translation text: GO ASK ZAINAB, HOW LAYLA FEELS\nWHEN SHE SEE’S YOU SHE’LL REMEMBER AKBAR\nTHE ONE WHO IS THE FATHER’S SUPPORT, HE IS DIGGING HIS HEELS (DYING)

arabic text: TUJHE DEEKH KE YAAD AYEGA SAJJAD KO MANZAR\nNAIYZE-KE SAHARE-SE, KHARA DEEKH RAHA HAI(N)\nNAIYZE-PE CHARHA KISKA, SAR YE JO PARA HAI(N)
english translation text: WHEN SAJJAD SEE’S YOU HE’LL REMEMBER THE EVENT\n(STANDING) WITH THE SUPPORT OF THE SPEAR, HE WAS WATCHING\nTHERE UPON THE SPEAR! WHOSE HEAD IS THAT?

arabic text: SHAYED MERE IMAM YE JAWAAB DAIN…
english translation text: PERHAPS MY IMAM WILL RESPOND BACK…

arabic text: 'MUJHE DEEKH KE BATAYEGA, ZAINAB KE MASAEB TU\nABBASALI KITNA, LIKH LIKH KE PARHE GA\nZAINAB-PE TO MASAEB, DIN RAAT PARE HAI(N)'
english translation text: 'WHEN YOU SEE ME YOU’LL TELL ME, WHAT BEFELL ON ZAINAB\nABBASALI HOW MUCH WILL YOU WRITE AND RETELL?\nFOR WHAT BEFELL ON ZAINAB, BEFELL ON HER DURING THE DAY AND THE NIGHT!'

arabic text: AIY MERE CHAHNE WAALE, TERI RAAHA DEKHTA HU(N)
english translation text: O THE ONE WHO LOVES ME, I’M AWAITING YOUR RETURN (TO ME).

arabic text: TUJHE DEEKH KE YAAD AYEGI,\nKARBAL KI KAAHANI AIY IMAM-E-ZAMANA MERI RAAHA DEKHTEY HAI(N) O IMAM-E-ZAMANA
english translation text: HE IS AWAITING MY RETURN (TO HIM).\nWHEN WE’LL SEE YOU WE’LL REMEMBER, THE EVENTS OF KARBALA
